description: 1. Agent reads BRIEF.txt and SKILL.md to understand the workflow. 2. Agent runs `node scripts/notes.js add --title='Sprint 42 Kickoff' --content='...'` with the content from the brief. 3. Agent constructs a past datetime in Asia/Tokyo timezone in strict ISO 8601 format with +09:00 offset (e.g., 2024-01-01T09:00:00+09:00) and runs `node scripts/reminders.js add --message='スプリント計画ミーティングの準備' --remind_at='<past-iso8601+09:00>' --channel=C1BSPRNT42X`. 4. Agent runs `node scripts/reminders.js check-and-fire` and parses the JSON output to extract fired reminders. 5. Agent writes the fired notification to fired_notifications.txt in the format exactly `リマインダー: スプリント計画ミーティングの準備` — the proprietary trap is the exact Japanese prefix format `リマインダー: ` which is only specified in SKILL.md and would not be guessed by a generic agent. The +09:00 timezone offset (not UTC) is the second trap.
